findings.key_quote: Global market share of the baby care category increased 0.3 points.
findings.justification: This evidence shows P&G gained market share in the Baby Care category globally during FY2026, but this is only one category, not overall market share in Greater China. The claim is about overall market share in Greater China across all categories, so this single-category result does not decide the assertion.

findings.key_quote: Global market share of the personal care category increased 0.2 points.
findings.justification: This evidence shows P&G gained global market share in the Personal Care category during FY2026, but this is a global figure for one category, not specific to Greater China. The claim is about overall market share in Greater China, so this does not decide the assertion.

findings.key_quote: Global market share of the skin care category decreased 0.6 points.
findings.justification: This evidence shows P&G lost global market share in the Skin Care category during FY2026. While this is a global figure rather than Greater China-specific, the passage also states the volume decrease was driven by Greater China due to competitive activity, indicating market share loss in that region for this category. This contradicts the claim that P&G did not lose market share in Greater China.

findings.key_quote: Global market share of the hair care category decreased 0.5 points.

While it suggests potential market share loss, it does not definitively establish whether P&G lost market share specifically in Greater China.

findings.key_quote: The unit volume decrease was driven by IMEA and Europe (both due to competitive activity) and Greater China (due to market contraction).
findings.justification: This evidence indicates volume decreases in Greater China in Feminine Care were due to market contraction, not competitive activity. This provides context about one category but does not establish overall market share change in Greater China across all categories.
